meta.title: Terminal-style input
meta.description: Terminal-style prompt history for the input box: Up/Down recalls the previous or next prompt, typing a prefix first narrows Up to history starting with it, and Ctrl+R searches backwards by keyword. Selecting text can raise a copy/quote toolbar or copy immediately; right-click pastes the clipboard; a draggable conversation directory can sit on the left edge. Chinese and English, nothing to configure.
